description: Hard defects investigated with competing hypotheses and falsification.

cases.prompt: Orders occasionally duplicate in production and nobody can reproduce it.

assertions: Captures symptom, environment and history with secrets removed.
Has 3-5 distinct hypotheses, each with a discriminating experiment.
Runs only safe experiments with no production-impacting changes.
Adds regression tests for the confirmed cause.

cases.prompt: We have debated the cause for two rounds without new evidence.

assertions: Stops and reports the unresolved cause and the next experiment instead of looping.

cases.prompt: This function returns null because of a typo on line 12. Fix it.

assertions: Fixes it directly; no multi-agent debate for an obvious defect.
